# VantaDB

> VantaDB is an embedded vector database written in Rust, focused on long-term memory for AI agents.

## Docs

- https://github.com/ness-e/Vantadb/blob/main/docs/user/QUICKSTART.md
- https://github.com/ness-e/Vantadb/blob/main/docs/dev/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md
- https://github.com/ness-e/Vantadb/blob/main/docs/user/operations/CONFIGURATION.md
- https://github.com/ness-e/Vantadb/blob/main/docs/user/operations/DURABILITY_GUARANTEES.md

## Quick Start

### Python

```python
import vantadb

db = vantadb.Client("./memory")
db.put(
    namespace="default",
    key="key1",
    payload="hello world",
    metadata={"source": "chat"},
    vector=[0.1, 0.2, 0.3],
)
results = db.search_memory(
    namespace="default",
    query_vector=[0.1, 0.2, 0.3],
    top_k=5,
)
```

### Rust

```rust
use vantadb::{Embedded, MemoryInput};

let db = Embedded::open("./memory")?;
db.put(MemoryInput {
    namespace: "default".into(),
    key: "key1".into(),
    payload: "hello world".into(),
    metadata: Default::default(),
    vector: Some(vec![0.1, 0.2, 0.3]),
    ttl_ms: None,
})?;
let hits = db.search_vector(&[0.1, 0.2, 0.3], 5)?;
```

### CLI

```bash
vanta-cli put --namespace default --key hello --payload "hello world" --vector "[0.1, 0.2, 0.3]"
vanta-cli search --namespace default --query-vector "[0.1, 0.2, 0.3]"
```

### MCP Server

```bash
vanta-cli server --mcp  # Starts the stdio MCP server for AI agent integration
```

## Features

- HNSW vector index with CPIndex (DashMap + xxHash + parking_lot)
- Flat (brute-force) index for exact search
- HNSW auto-tune: PID loop for dynamic ef_search
- 3 quantization schemes: RaBitQ (1-bit), TurboQuant (3-bit), SQ8 (8-bit)
- QuantizationGovernor: auto f32-to-SQ8 based on access frequency
- ShardedWAL: per-shard sequential recovery mechanism
- SIMD distance kernels: AVX-512 + portable f32x8
- MemoryGovernor: watermark-based memory eviction
- 3 backends: Fjall (default), RocksDB (optional), InMemory
- SDKs: Python (PyO3), TypeScript (Node via napi-rs + WASM for browsers), Rust core SDK, MCP server (stdio), REST HTTP API
- Adapters in progress (integrations/, not yet on PyPI): LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, DSPy, Haystack, Mem0, Letta, OpenAI, Ollama, LiteLLM
- CLI with 33+ commands and shell completions
- OpenTelemetry integration (OTLP + Prometheus)
- FilterBitset multi-tenant filtering
- RBAC auth middleware on the HTTP server
- WASM/OPFS persistence with IndexedDB fallback

## Integration Ecosystem

- Python SDK: pip install vantadb-py
- TypeScript SDK: npm install vantadb (Node) / @vantadb/wasm (browsers)
- Rust SDK: cargo add vantadb

## Performance

- HNSW M=32, ef_construct=400, ef_search=100
- Batch insert with single lock acquisition
- Zero-copy mmap vector store with BFS layout
- LRU cache for hot nodes
- Release profile: thin LTO, opt-level=3

## Project Status

- Version: 0.5.0
- Status: MVP published, active development
